sources.title: Antonin Chambolle and Thomas Pock, A First-Order Primal-Dual Algorithm for Convex Problems with Applications to Imaging
sources.locator: Complete 51-page report. §2, Algorithm 1, and §3.1, printed pp. 2–7.
sources.source_kind_detail: Full author-hosted research report. Read the saddle formulation, exact primal-dual recurrence, strict step condition, and stated convergence scope.

contents.name: §2 Algorithm 1: primal-dual hybrid-gradient recurrence and step condition
contents.detail: The authored procedure uses the exact recurrence and strict step-size condition. Its finite solver/checker wrapper and certificates are local additions; no finite discovery guarantee is imported.

contents.name: §3.1 proper closed convex primal-dual input framework
contents.detail: The report supplies the generic convexity precondition. The local lemma verifies that the specific l1 objective and residual-ball indicator meet it.
